entry.title: [BZ 26] Diablo 5 Set for Spring 2029, Initial Details Revealed; New Class “Plague Knight” and More to Be Added (translated)
entry.summary: Diablo 5 is expected to launch in spring 2029, still nearly three years away; BlizzCon 2026 first revealed the new class and initial setting, with the story beginning as Diablo conquers Sanctuary and the locals and souls are drawn into the Eternal Conflict. For now, the reveal sketches out what players are waiting for and the direction the world is set to take.

entry.title: 【BZ 26】Blizzard’s Next Chapter Officially Begins! New StarCraft Shooter, Diablo 5, and World of Warcraft: Eternal Revealed, and More (translated)
entry.summary: Returning after a two-year hiatus, BlizzCon 2026 brought the future directions of several Blizzard titles together before players: a new StarCraft shooter, Diablo 5, and World of Warcraft: Eternal appeared, while Heroes of the Storm and Warcraft 3: Reforged also received content updates, turning the event into a look ahead across multiple fronts.

entry.title: [Interview] Why Is Hearthstone's New Class a Monk? (translated)
entry.summary: At BlizzCon 2026, Hearthstone laid out its upcoming content as an update roadmap running from the near term to the long term: The Dark Empire's Ascendancy launches on October 20, set in an ancient Azeroth where the Old Gods and Titans fought, and introduces the “Combination” keyword, which can merge the elements of two cards; Battlegrounds will add the “Mutant” tribe, whose members awaken sleeping Old Gods when they die, and the journal has also been revised to bring stories, quests, achievements, and events together in one place. The team has also scheduled a steady stream of events and gameplay additions over the next nine months, beginning with a 2v2 Tavern Brawl to test co-op play; the new Monk class is expected to be added in March 2027. Executive Producer Nathan Lyons-Smith and Senior Game Design Manager Brendan Sewell said these plans both respond to players’ survey preference for the Monk and aim to give them reasons to keep coming back during gaps between card-set releases.

entry.title: BlizzCon 2026 New Releases Roundup: New StarCraft Game and Diablo V Revealed for the First Time en (translated)
entry.summary: BlizzCon 2026 returned to Anaheim, California, on September 13, three years after the previous event held in 2023, under the theme “The Next Chapter.” This year’s announcements spanned both the near and distant future: Heroes of the Storm will add Xal’atath on September 29, Diablo IV will introduce the Hellfire Season Legacy on September 15, and World of Warcraft: Eternity will enter beta on September 17 before its official release on November 4; the long-term focus includes a new open-world shooter set in the StarCraft universe, planned for release in 2030, and Diablo V, set in a destroyed Sanctuary and arriving in spring 2029. The event also brought a new Hearthstone expansion, the Amazon Warrior for Diablo IV in 2027, and the Warcraft III: Reforged 3.0 update, leaving players to separate their expectations for near-term content from those for games still years away.

entry.title: Physint Shifts to Xbox, Report Says Death Stranding Revenue Fell Short of Sony’s Expectations (translated)
entry.summary: Physint was originally backed by Sony Interactive Entertainment, but later moved to a partnership with Xbox. Bloomberg, citing people familiar with the matter, reported that the split was driven in part by revenue from the Death Stranding series falling short of Sony’s expectations, as well as Physint falling behind schedule and going seriously over budget. The failure of Concord also led PlayStation to tighten its production schedules, further intensifying the pressure between the project and the platform. Because the later Xbox and PC versions of Death Stranding were not published by Sony, the company’s assessment of its investment costs and how it could recoup them also formed part of the background. Hideo Kojima’s upcoming OD and Physint are now both being funded and published by Xbox, with the agreement also including film and television adaptation rights.

entry.title: Roblox Plans to Launch a Standalone Gaming App and Let Players Play Directly in Chrome (translated)
entry.summary: Roblox is preparing to take its games beyond the boundaries of its original platform, with direct play through Chrome potentially arriving as early as this year. RDC 2026 also announced plans for a standalone gaming app, giving creators' work a chance to reach players outside Roblox. As the number of platform entry points grows, both the reach of games and the ways people play them will expand as well.

entry.title: Line for Lineage’s Papuri온 Total War on-site registration fills up early (translated)
entry.summary: The “Papuri온 Total War” event is being held in Gwangju, South Korea, from September 12 to 13. On-site registration for the first day closed early after players began lining up during the night of the 11th, with the queue exceeding 200 people before midnight. Players who secured group-battle eligibility through the lottery can still participate, while visitors unable to enter can receive a welcome coupon containing a Papuri온 Expeditionary Force Box. On-site queuing remains available on the second day, but attendees must arrive after 7 a.m.

entry.title: World of Warcraft: Forever promises players another way to experience this online RPG (translated)
entry.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is scheduled to launch on November 4, with a beta opening first on September 17. Those who want to enter early can purchase early-access eligibility, and it will stand alongside the standard version and Classic as the third way to play World of Warcraft. Blizzard positions it as “a new beginning”: players will explore new areas such as Mount Hyjal and Riverlands in an Azeroth different from the one they remember, and can choose Forsaken Paladin, Dwarf Shaman, and the new Skyborne race when creating a character. The content also includes new quests, more group-oriented areas, and a permanent level-60 cap. The studio hopes players will progress at their own pace and will continue updating content across all level ranges after launch, allowing this new path to serve both players who want to tackle group content and those who simply want to explore the world.

entry.title: ChuApp's Major Game Industry Stories This Week: PIF Considers Integrating EA and Savvy Games, Honor of Kings Chess Goes Live, Travel Frog: China Journey Announces Service Shutdown (translated)
entry.summary: This week's roundup brings together Beijing's Shijingshan District offering of up to RMB 5 million in subsidies for games and esports, the launch performance of Tencent's new title, and the shutdown of a game. It also notes that PIF is considering integrating EA and Savvy Games. From policy funding and product performance to changes in corporate structure, it presents an industry being shaped simultaneously by multiple forces.

entry.title: Blizzard unveils the first details of World of Warcraft's next major expansion (translated)
entry.summary: The Last Titan is the third and final chapter of World of Warcraft's Worldsoul Saga. At the opening ceremony of BlizzCon 2026, Blizzard unveiled this finale in a short trailer and used the phrase “Bring the war back to Warcraft” to hint at the story's direction; at the same event, it first showcased the Midnight update “Eclipse,” and Ion Hazzikostas said the story would accelerate at full speed. Blizzard previewed more details after Eclipse, early next year, giving the conclusion of this long-form saga a clear waiting point.

entry.title: Crazy! Graphics card prices are absurdly high, yet gamers are buying more (translated)
entry.summary: In the second quarter of 2026, graphics card prices were absurdly high, yet the number entering stores rose to 12.5 million units, a four-year high; the report cited analysts who attributed this abnormal demand to panic, creating a situation in which prices and purchase volumes rose in the same direction, making the contrast between high prices and heavy buying the report’s central theme.

entry.title: All-New StarCraft: What Will This Open-World Shooter Be Like? (translated)
entry.summary: At BlizzCon 2026, Blizzard announced that StarCraft will return as an open-world shooter, putting the classic real-time strategy series through a genre rewrite. After Dan Hay took the stage, the trailer followed a Terran soldier training for the Dominion and heading into battle; after landing, he was overwhelmed by the Zerg, ran out of ammunition, and was plunged into chaos, making the feeling of wartime sacrifice its first impression. Planned for release in 2030, the game will now have to prove that its familiar universe can be turned into a viable open-world shooter experience.

entry.title: Xanthe in The Blood of Dawnwalker: How to Beat This Boss, and Should You Spare Her? (translated)
entry.summary: Xanthe in The Blood of Dawnwalker is more than a boss who must be defeated: she is both a Vrakhir and a blood witch; after the fight, players can choose to execute her or drain her blood, with the latter granting the vampire talent “Blood Explosion” and the associated trophy, while accepting her soul in Anachore also allows her to assist the final battle as a ghost. The guide lays out two encounter routes: entering Svartrau Cathedral at night leads directly to a fight against three dual-blade warriors and an instant-death countdown; attacking her stronghold in southeastern Val Sangora first and making enough progress lets players obtain a special lamp for entering the southern swamp fortress. During the battle, players must also deal with teleportation, red orbs, and the healing mechanic.

entry.title: What BlizzCon 2026’s Opening Revealed: a New Warcraft III Campaign, WoW’s “Eternity” Version, a StarCraft Shooter, and Diablo V (translated)
entry.summary: BlizzCon had been on hiatus since 2019, and the previous full opening ceremony was held in 2023; its return in 2026 used a 90-minute opening to run multiple Blizzard product lines in parallel. StarCraft is returning as an open-world shooter, scheduled for 2030; Diablo V is planned for spring 2029, with a theme centered on a Sanctuary conquered by Diablo. Diablo IV arrives on Switch 2 on September 15 for $70, with the Amazon class joining in the first half of 2027; Overwatch support hero Doctrine is scheduled to go live with Season Five on October 6, and Hearthstone’s new expansion is set for October 20. Joanna Farris discussed the importance of the festival in the opening, and the return also became an overview of the schedules for each series.

entry.title: Warcraft III Reforged launches Forsaken Kingdom: its first story campaign in 20 years is now live (translated)
entry.summary: The new Forsaken Kingdom campaign for Warcraft III Reforged launched on Battle.net on September 12, 2026, marking the game's first new story campaign in 23 years. The story brings players back to Lordaeron and its surrounding areas: residents killed by the Scourge and resurrected as undead fight for their homeland under the leadership of Sylvanas Windrunner, while establishing the Undercity underground, surrounded by enemies. The campaign consists of a prologue and three chapters, runs for about 30 hours, adds an undead paladin hero, and is not restricted by which version of the strategy game the player owns. The expansion costs $30 on its own or $50 bundled with Warcraft III: Reforged; the Definitive Edition released alongside it also updates the visuals and map editor.

entry.title: The Royal Romance History Mid-Autumn Return Event Starts on September 11, Offering Selectable Character and Appearance Packs (translated)
entry.summary: During the Mid-Autumn return event in Kingdom Idle Battle, players who have not logged in for 30 consecutive days and have reached at least the Junior Legendary Lord rank will receive selectable packs containing featured characters, appearances, NPCs, and furniture, along with progression resources and lottery items. Returning lords can unlock the Growth and Cultivation quests, attend the VIP banquet, and obtain Mid-Autumn-exclusive rewards. The event also links up with the whole-server celebration “A Thousand Miles Beneath the Same Moon,” with the number of days the banquet remains open determined by the server-wide progress accumulated by players. Eating mooncakes increases the Obesity value, unlocking a special lord form and additional fragment rewards.

entry.title: The Made in Abyss Mobile Game Adaptation Announces a Delay (translated)
entry.summary: This mobile game adapted from the anime has announced a delay, so players will have to push back both their anticipation for its release and their plans to play it. The game was originally built around collecting relics, developing characters, and challenging powerful enemies; with this change, the wait itself has become something players need to take into account. For those looking forward to the adaptation, whether to commit to pre-orders or the promotional hype can still be decided later, once the follow-up arrangements become clearer.

entry.title: Fantasy Life i: The Girl Who Steals Time Announces Major Paid DLC “The Celestial Train and the Terminal of Happiness” (translated)
entry.summary: Fantasy Life i: The Girl Who Steals Time will expand its existing content through a major paid DLC, covering life professions, the crafting system, and the adventure experience. This plan gives players who have already invested in the base game another route for continuing to play, while focusing the next decision on the added content’s actual scope, price, and release schedule.

entry.title: Warframe Launches Major Update, Growing Larger Than Ever After 13 Years (translated)
entry.summary: As Warframe enters its 13th year, creative director Rebecca Ford discusses how the team balances continuing to expand the world with responding to the needs of veteran players. The Iceblade of Narin, launching on September 23, will add a new Warframe and an in-game hub, followed by a special event on October 15 that takes players to the Tau System. The team is also preparing Glacial Defense, a six-player co-op mode, to test whether high-level players are looking for more challenging team content.

entry.title: Two Point Hospital: Heartfelt Collection Looks Back on the Studio’s Ten Years and Introduces the Series’ Appeal (translated)
entry.summary: This PR content provided by the publisher uses the studio’s ten-year history as its backdrop to introduce the latest entry in the Two Point series, Two Point Hospital: Heartfelt Collection, focusing on the series’ accumulated strengths and its humorous management gameplay. For players, the series’ past experience can provide a reference for understanding the tone of the game, but the appeal described in the promotion should still be assessed separately from the actual performance of its systems.

entry.title: Tree of Savior: Neverland Opens a Ten-Day Limited-Time Fast-Progression Server (translated)
entry.summary: Tree of Savior: Neverland has launched a ten-day limited-time server that lets players progress quickly and obtain costumes, lowering the barrier to returning to long-term character development. The design suits players who want to come back or try the game for a short period, while the ten-day event window clearly defines the available experience. Players can treat it as a brief return without immediately committing to long-term play.

entry.title: The Game The Wandering Earth: Gazing at the Sun Trends Again, Report Calls on Players to Stay Rational (translated)
entry.summary: After remaining quiet for some time, discussions related to The Wandering Earth returned to the trending searches because of the game version, with the report focusing specifically on the IP-based game rather than the film itself. This wave of discussion can help players notice the work more quickly, but it also serves as a reminder that a familiar fictional universe and a work’s actual quality are two different things; whether it is worth investing in should still come down to the game itself.

entry.title: AI Allegedly Misused the Voices of 63 Genshin Impact Characters; miHoYo Awarded 750,000 Yuan (translated)
entry.summary: The voices of 63 Genshin Impact characters were allegedly misused by AI, with the case ultimately ending in miHoYo receiving 750,000 yuan in compensation. The case brings the boundaries of generative AI's use of game voice assets back from the convenience of technology to questions of authorisation, character recognition, and the assignment of responsibility. It also makes whether voices can be copied at will an issue that both players and the industry must confront.

entry.title: Roblox Farming Game Links Player Spending to Supporting Indonesian Farmers (translated)
entry.summary: Roblox game The Hardest Farming Game connects virtual farming and Robux spending with a brand-led social initiative supporting Indonesian farmers, giving players’ in-game actions an additional real-world direction while making the way the campaign fulfils its promise an important part of the equation.

entry.title: GTA 6 Promotional Partnership Reportedly Brings Record-Breaking Subscriptions to Netflix (translated)
entry.summary: The promotional buzz around GTA 6 spread beyond the gaming community through Netflix. A 27-minute video released through a partnership between Rockstar and Netflix amassed more than 31 million views during its six-hour exclusive run, and topped the trending charts in 87 of 93 countries. Ampere Analysis said that Netflix in the United States added more than 100,000 accounts on 27 August, marking its third-highest new-subscription peak of 2026; more than 5% of US members who had not used the service for over 30 days also returned to watch that month. The partnership brought Netflix new users and returning members, while helping Rockstar reach audiences beyond its traditional player base.

entry.title: The Market Sees GTA 6 as the Saviour of Global Console Revenue (translated)
entry.summary: Newzoo’s Global Games Report identifies GTA 6 as a key pillar of this year’s console market, arguing that without the game, global console revenue would fall below the same period last year. The game is scheduled to launch on 19 November 2026, and preorder estimates have already placed it at the top of the console adventure category by revenue. The market even predicts that its first-day revenue could reach $1 billion. It could drive console players, spending, and upgrades to ninth-generation consoles, but it could also draw attention and budgets away from other releases arriving in November.

entry.title: Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko’s Mystery Dungeon – Classic HD Arrives on Mobile in Japan en (translated)
entry.summary: Square Enix has brought the 1993 dungeon RPG Torneko’s Mystery Dungeon – Classic HD to Japan’s mobile market, where it is now available on Android and iOS as a paid release. The port gives an early entry in the series a new way to be played, while allowing longtime players to revisit it on their phones.

entry.title: eFootball 2027 Summer Transfer Vol. 3 Pack Review and Development Recommendations (translated)
entry.summary: The third Summer Transfer release in eFootball 2027 places Araújo, Stones, and Akliouche in the same pack, giving players three angles for planning their investment: pulling, development, and skill configuration. The review pays particular attention to how Araújo and Stones improve the defensive line, while also整理ing each card’s stats and suitable skill development paths, so the decision does not stop at comparing rarity alone.

entry.title: The Akina Occult Research Institute: A Mage Clan Disguised as a Film Club (translated)
entry.summary: In Astra: Overture, the Akina Occult Research Institute appears to be the “Slash and Flesh” film appreciation club at Okuma High School, but is actually a mage clan based in Shinjuku. Its members collect and analyse urban legends circulating through the city before tracking down the entities behind them; the director, Akitsu Akina, uses magical tools made by combining alchemy and chemistry, though she rarely produces anything genuinely practical. In front of her friends, Kagamihara Haru is a pure and proper girl, but in private she is obsessed with B-movie gore; Asakura Mai, meanwhile, places athletics and an ordinary life ahead of her identity as a mage, creating three sharply different sides to the cast.

entry.title: Krafton Named a Korea Best Workplace for the Fifth Time en (translated)
entry.summary: Krafton has been named a “Korea Best Workplace” for the fifth time, while also presenting its family-friendly policies and investment in an AI First transformation. Since 2025, Krafton has expanded support for childbirth and childcare, including career support of up to KRW 100 million per child, parental leave of up to two years, and work-from-home arrangements for employees caring for their children. The company also said that, starting in 2026, it will allocate approximately KRW 30 billion annually to support AI tools and training. Han So-young, head of HR, said this represents the results of improving both the quantity and quality of work.

entry.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX Modern Remake Coming in 2027 (translated)
entry.summary: The GX series remake, TAG FORCE GX, is scheduled to launch on February 16, 2027, for Steam and Nintendo Switch, with Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese support for the first time. For players who have been waiting for years, this version removes language as one of the barriers to returning to the old game; whether it is worth buying again will still depend on whether the remake content can justify this comeback.

entry.title: GXG 2026 Game Culture Festival Opens in Seongnam (translated)
entry.summary: GXG 2026 is being held from September 11 to 12 around Banpo Station Plaza and Tech One Tower. The opening ceremony on the first day is hosted by Seongnam City and co-hosted by the Seongnam Industry Promotion Agency and the Game Culture Foundation, with a celebratory performance by Dynamic Duo. The event offers not only gaming and creative experiences, but also a range of exhibitions and stage programmes. The second day will also feature the AI GSDC awards ceremony and a concert, bringing games, creators, and audiences together in the same space.

entry.title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIV: Power-Up Legacy Edition launches, but some old save files cannot carry over (translated)
entry.summary: Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIV with Power-Up Legacy Edition launched on PS5, PS4, Switch, and Steam on 10 September. It combines most of the DLC from the base game, Power-Up Kit, and two season passes, while adding systems such as military intelligence, merit, policies, and scenic sites. The new mechanics make intelligence resources affect diplomacy and the success rate of stratagems, and link officers’ positions to the development of their faction. However, old save files can only carry over new officers, edited data, and custom images; existing game progress cannot be continued directly, and PS4 saves cannot be inherited on PS5. The title was developed under the direction of Koei Tecmo in Tianjin, with the team retaining the original large-scale map and territorial-management pace while adding 190 historical events, 100 scenic sites, and further rule adjustments.

entry.title: GTA 6 will enter real-life Miami with a $3 million marketing campaign (translated)
entry.summary: The Miami Beach City Commission narrowly approved the proposal by a vote of 4–3, allowing negotiations with Rockstar over a GTA 6 marketing partnership worth at least $3 million. The plan would have Boucher Brothers discreetly place the game's logo on chairs and umbrellas without using city property or landmarks; supporters say it would not affect city operations, while opponents worry that the criminal image portrayed by the game could undermine the city brand Miami Beach has worked to build, turning promotion for a game scheduled to launch on November 19 into a local-governance dispute.

entry.title: Pokémon TCG launches 30th-anniversary Mewtwo special card, available in limited quantities at select retailers (translated)
entry.summary: The second wave of Pokémon’s 30th-anniversary TCG products will launch on October 2. The Mewtwo promotional card illustrated by Nagisimo will not be included in regular booster packs, but will instead be available exclusively through U.S. retailers including GameStop, Best Buy, and Hot Topic. Players must spend at least $15 at a participating retailer to receive it; the card arrives the same day as the new products, putting collectors in competition over preorders, queues, and limited distributions.

entry.title: The Witcher 3 Originally Planned to Add Chain Weapons, but Technical Problems Delayed Them for Years (translated)
entry.summary: The Witcher 3 was originally planned to add chain weapons in 2015, but technical obstacles delayed them, and they did not have another chance to return to players until the remake and expansion. This experience brought the cut content back into focus, while also showing how a feature’s journey from design and postponement to eventual implementation is often shaped by technical conditions and the project’s later plans.

entry.title: Rockstar Tightens Studio Security to Prevent GTA 6 Material Leaks (translated)
entry.summary: The secrecy surrounding GTA 6 before its release has extended to studio access controls and office spaces. Rockstar revealed that the team has to guard against the many ways players might try to obtain unreleased material; as anticipation grows, the development site also needs more protection, tying the order in which the game is revealed to the team’s working environment.

entry.title: Former Blizzard employee says homemade AI technology makes sci-fi game development 93 times faster (translated)
entry.summary: A developer who left Blizzard says he built tools for the sci-fi game he has been working on for years, using AI to increase his production speed 93-fold. The claim describes the results of tools used in a personal project; the point is not to present a universally applicable method, but to ask whether AI can give small teams room for more experimentation and creative choices.

entry.title: Switch 2 Update Adds TV VRR, Promising Smoother Gameplay (translated)
entry.summary: Nintendo's Switch 2 system update 23.0.0 finally enables TV VRR in docked mode. By synchronising the TV's refresh rate with the game's frame rate, it improves screen tearing and minor stutters. However, the feature requires an HDMI 2.1-compatible TV, and the game itself must also include support for it; at present, only Nintendo Switch 2 Welcome Tour can use it, while other titles still have to wait for individual updates.

entry.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker Quest Guide: Choose the Right Item to Complete the Curse (translated)
entry.summary: The “Matters of the Heart” quest in The Blood of Dawnwalker requires players to investigate Andreï and choose the item used to cast the curse from a ring, a necklace, and a butcher’s cleaver. The correct answer is the ring; players must then distract the guards by the window to complete the ritual and influence Ocha’s subsequent choices.

entry.title: After Two Years of Fighting, Blizzard Employees Secure an Agreement for Two Remote-Work Days per Week (translated)
entry.summary: After two years of negotiations, nearly 1,900 Blizzard employees ratified their first collective agreement, putting a hybrid system of three days in the office and two days working remotely each week into the contract. The company can no longer unilaterally change it to four or five days on site. The agreement also covers fully remote employees, disability-related accommodations, priority rehiring across studios within 14 months after layoffs, and consultation with employee representatives before introducing AI that affects working conditions.

entry.title: Danganronpa 2×2 Confirmed for Release on January 14, 2027 (translated)
entry.summary: Danganronpa 2×2 has been confirmed for release on January 14, 2027, and Spike Chunsoft has also unveiled trial footage centred on the new story element “Madness Mode”. By presenting the release schedule alongside the new content, the announcement gives series players an early look at how the game will extend the familiar deduction and trial gameplay.

entry.title: Two Kirby Air Riders amiibo Launch on November 12 (translated)
entry.summary: The two Kirby Air Riders amiibo have been confirmed for release on November 12, 2026. The announced pairings are “Sword Kirby & Dragoon” and “Shadow King Dedede & Hydra.” These products extend the game’s characters into physical collectibles, allowing players to decide whether to buy them based on how much they enjoy the work.

entry.title: Onyx: The Dark Grip Confirmed for Switch 2 in 2027 (translated)
entry.summary: Bloober Team has unveiled its new title, Onyx: The Dark Grip, which is scheduled to launch on Switch 2 in 2027. The game lets players intervene in the world through supernatural powers, while also affecting the protagonist’s mental state, bringing the ability to alter the environment and its psychological cost into the same gameplay system.

entry.title: Onyx: The Dark Grip Confirmed for Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027 (translated)
entry.summary: Bloober Team has announced that this new supernatural title will be released on Nintendo Switch 2, with a launch planned for 2027. The game lets players control the protagonist as they interfere with the surrounding world, while those actions in turn affect the protagonist’s mental state; as a result, players are not simply dealing with anomalous events, but facing the survival pressure that every intervention may carry a psychological cost.

entry.title: Nintendo Direct Announces a Large Lineup of Switch 2 Games, Including New Kirby and Metroid Titles (translated)
entry.summary: During the approximately 45-minute Nintendo Direct on September 9, Nintendo announced the Switch 2 lineup extending from winter 2026 through 2027. The presentation focused mainly on ports of existing major releases, enhanced editions, and multiplatform titles, while also adding new games such as Metroid: Luminara and Kirby: World Beyond. Monster Hunter: Wilds is scheduled to launch on December 4, 2026, while Final Fantasy VII Revelation is set for April 8, 2027; some titles became available for distribution or received demo versions after the livestream, allowing players to decide earlier whether they want to commit.

entry.title: Persona 4 Revival and Persona 6 Confirmed for Switch 2 (translated)
entry.summary: SEGA revealed during Nintendo Direct that Persona 4 Revival and Persona 6 will be coming to Switch 2. Persona 4 Revival is a brand-new remake of Persona 4 Golden, retaining the original story while improving its visuals and feel of control; the Switch 2 version is scheduled to launch on May 20, later than the February 18 release on other platforms. Persona 6, meanwhile, has been confirmed for the new console, marking a new development for the series' next mainline installment.

entry.title: Dead or Alive 6 Last Round Reveals Trailer for Minato, a Tokyo High School Girl Character (translated)
entry.summary: Dead or Alive 6 Last Round has released a trailer introducing the new character Minato. She is a student from Tokyo and a dance competition champion, and she will join the game’s story with this background; current coverage focuses mainly on her character setup and the trailer video, giving players an initial sense of her role in the game’s introduction.

entry.title: Dead or Alive 6: Last Round Reveals Tokyo High School Student Character Minato in Debut Trailer (translated)
entry.summary: Koei Tecmo Games has released a debut trailer for Minato, a new character in Dead or Alive 6: Last Round. Minato appears as a Tokyo student and dance competition champion, and becomes caught up in an incident after taking a part-time job helping the scientist Nicole; her character background first sketches the contrast between everyday student life and the fighting stage, while her lasting appeal will still depend on her actual combat performance and how she is obtained.

entry.title: The Switch 2 version of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time will respond to humming and instrument sounds, letting Link play the Ocarina of Time (translated)
entry.summary: The Switch 2 version of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has announced a feature that directly incorporates players’ voices into gameplay: Link will not only respond to button inputs on the controller, but can also trigger the game’s playing effects when players hum or even play the game-themed ocarina scheduled for release. This design turns an instrument originally played by the character into a medium for interaction between the player and the game; after the news was revealed, fans began discussing whether they could try other instruments, while some worried about their own pitch. The game is scheduled to launch on November 5, 2026.

entry.title: SEGA: 60–70% of Like a Dragon merchandise buyers are women, and fans do not necessarily need to play the game themselves (translated)
entry.summary: In an interview, SEGA president Hideki Utsumi said that approximately 60% to 70% of buyers of Like a Dragon merchandise are women. Many of them first encounter the series through videos, livestreams, or YouTube channels, then become interested in its world, story, and characters before eventually buying related products, even though they may never have played the game themselves. Utsumi considers these fans who have not played the game to be SEGA supporters as well, and they may even be more deeply invested in the IP than people who actually play it. This view emerged as SEGA discussed its cross-media strategy, reflecting the company’s effort to treat games, video productions, stage performances, and lifestyle merchandise as interconnected entry points for fans.

entry.title: NC’s Cinder City Will Launch First on PC as a Paid Package (translated)
entry.summary: NC announced that Cinder City will use a paid-package model in which players purchase the base game before entering the service, rather than launching as a free-to-play title; the PC version will first release as a full version, with console versions following later. After launch, the game will still add a shop selling cosmetic items and a battle pass, including outfits, accessories, and weapon decorations. The development team said these items will only change appearance and will not affect character performance. Live-service updates are expected to add new stories, related missions, and co-op dungeons, but paid expansion content is not part of the current plans; cross-platform play between PC and consoles also remains undecided.

entry.title: Cat Me If You Can Launches on Steam Today (translated)
entry.summary: Cat Me If You Can, a 3D hand-drawn-style cat-finding adventure developed by the independent team The Cosmic Stag Games and published by Craftmos Games, has officially launched on Steam and supports Korean. Players will explore scenes set across different eras and cultural backgrounds in a world transformed into a black-and-white comic, using a camera to photograph the cats they find and gradually restore their colour. The full release features more than 725 cats with distinct appearances, some hidden in areas that require players to operate mechanisms, collect items, or unravel clues to access. It also includes more than 50 puzzles and quests. A 10% launch-week discount is available at the same time.

entry.title: EGDF: Apple’s New Business Terms Continue to Undermine Fair Competition (translated)
entry.summary: The European Games Developer Federation (EGDF) and 17 other organisations representing app developers, digital businesses, news publishers, consumers and civil society groups have issued a joint open letter questioning whether Apple’s new business terms, which will take effect in October, have resolved its compliance problems under the Digital Markets Act. The groups argue that excessive fees and restrictive conditions will weaken alternative distribution channels, narrowing the room for choice, competition and innovation for developers and players. They are therefore asking the European Commission to hear from affected businesses before completing its assessment, and to explain the progress of the relevant procedure and how it will be handled next.

entry.title: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam Finally Gets a Release Date After Years of Delays (translated)
entry.summary: Level-5 announced during the September Nintendo Direct that Professor Layton and the New World of Steam will launch on December 10, 2026, finally giving a firm date to a new entry whose schedule had been changed by delays. Professor Layton and Luke will travel to Steam Bison, an American town developing at remarkable speed while a string of mysterious incidents unfolds; it is also the series’ first entirely new mainline entry since 2013’s Professor Layton and the Azran Legacy.

entry.title: The Arknights and Persona 3 Reload collaboration sparks excitement across overseas communities (translated)
entry.summary: After the Arknights and Persona 3 Reload collaboration event “Moonlit Journey Across Water” went live, its promotional video drew hundreds of thousands of views across overseas communities on YouTube, X, and other platforms. The discussion even spread to the Persona 3 Reload subreddit. Many players of the original game were introduced to Arknights as a result, while others went the other way and asked how to get into Persona 3 Reload. However, version progress differs between servers, so some overseas players still have to wait for the event to become available.

entry.title: 2025’s Best Psychological Horror Game Is Getting an Official Sequel Manga (translated)
entry.summary: Konami and Weekly Famitsu have announced that a new manga based on Silent Hill f will begin serialization at the end of 2026, with Kotoyuki, the figure wearing a fox mask, taking over as the story’s protagonist. The work will be divided into two parts. The first will look back on his childhood and how he became “the man behind the fox mask”; manga artist Ayato will create the series, with Silent Hill f writer Ryukishi07 and Konami jointly supervising it, allowing this extended story to supplement the series’ world first in manga form.

entry.title: EGDF: Apple's New Business Terms Continue to Undermine Fair Competition (translated)
entry.summary: The European Game Developers Federation and 17 other organisations representing app developers, digital businesses, news media, consumers and civil society groups sent a joint letter criticising Apple's new business terms proposed in the EU, arguing that they still fail to resolve compliance concerns under the Digital Markets Act. The signatories believe that excessive fees and restrictive conditions could make it difficult for alternative distribution channels to develop effective competition, further affecting the choices available to developers and players as well as the space for innovation; they called on the European Commission to consult affected groups before making a decision and to improve the transparency of the relevant process.

entry.title: EGDF: Apple’s New Business Terms Continue to Undermine Fair Competition (translated)
entry.summary: The European Game Developers Federation (EGDF), together with 17 other organisations representing app developers, digital businesses, news publishers, consumers, and civil society groups, sent a joint letter questioning whether Apple’s new business terms introduced in the EU have resolved its compliance issues under the Digital Markets Act (DMA). Instead, the terms may weaken alternative distribution channels through high fees and restrictive conditions, narrowing the room for choice and innovation available to developers and players. The signatories called on the European Commission to consult affected businesses when assessing the terms and to explain the progress of the relevant DMA proceedings and how they will ultimately be concluded.

entry.title: Pokémon Stamp Mini-Sheet Goes on Sale November 20, with a Total Issue of 300,000 Sheets (translated)
entry.summary: The Pokémon stamp mini-sheet is scheduled to go on sale on November 20, with an issue of 300,000 sheets. Each sheet contains 10 stamps and is being released in conjunction with the 2026 Taipei World Stamp Championship. The product brings the Pokémon game IP into the postal collectibles market once again, giving collectors another physical option for commemorating it.
